newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent and gas oil spike to highs at close.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent and gas oil spike to highs at close.

text.p: IPE Brent futures ended at the highs for the day after short-covering into the close pushed the market higher in thin volume, traders said.
January Brent last traded 17 cents up at $22.82 a barrel after hovering in mid-range at $22.60 for much of the day, with little fresh news to offer direction.
The market was quiet for most of the day due partly due to the lack of arbitrage business with the NYMEX shut for Thanksgiving.

The spot market for prompt Brent cargoes talked steady to firmer some 35 cents above January paper with a combination of tight Urals avails, talk of a possible conclusion to the French truckers' strike which has dulled demand from French refiners and the keeping of all five Brent dates turning wet today supportive.

Some dealers believe the weather in Europe and the U.S. will be pivotal to the next price move. Independent forecaster Weather Services Corp (WSC) said on Friday a cold November had resulted in higher than normal heating demand in the northeast U.S. but milder temperatures were seen for early December.
December gas oil also spike higher on the close to end $2.75 a tonne firmer at $220.50 a tonne the day's high. -- London newsroom +44 171 542 7456
